title: Console: Route detail view w/ model breakdown + prior-period comparison
author: Felix Schneider
body:
Title: Console UI route detail view (model breakdown + compare to prior period)

Context
This PR implements the console “Route detail” page for Usage Insights. It builds on the route list view (PR #15470) and consumes the route detail API (PR #15462). The goal is to let customers drill into a single route and answer:
- Which models/variants are driving cost for this route?
- What changed vs the prior period (tokens, cost, latency, errors)?

What’s included (UI)
- New RouteDetail page at /console/usage/insights/routes/:routeId (behind feature flag: usage_insights_route_detail)
- Summary header:
  - Route name + normalized route ID
  - Date range selector (shared component)
  - “Compare to prior period” toggle (default off)
- KPI strip:
  - Total cost, input tokens, output tokens, cached tokens (when present)
  - p50/p95 latency, error rate
  - When compare is enabled: delta + percent change (vs prior period of equal duration)
- Model breakdown section:
  - Table (default) with per-model spend ranking + tokens + p95 latency + error rate
  - Optional stacked bar visualization for cost share (enabled only when <= 12 models after server-side limit)
  - “Other” rollup row when model cardinality exceeds server cap
- “What changed” callouts when compare is enabled:
  - Top 3 models by absolute cost increase
  - “Cost share shift” indicator when the top model changes
- Empty and partial-data states:
  - “No data for this route in selected time range” empty state
  - “Route tagging missing” helper when API returns route=unknown / gateway-derived placeholder
  - Skeleton loading state + retry affordance on transient failures

UX / product notes (per design review)
- Copy adjustments:
  - Changed label from “WoW” to “vs previous period” to match PM guidance.
  - Added tooltip definitions for cached tokens and “unit cost” (unit cost is hidden here for now; only in list view).
- Table layout:
  - Cost column is pinned left on wide screens; model name is primary sort key only when costs are tied.
  - Added “show N” pagination control for model table (10/25/50) with server pagination.
- Accessibility:
  - Table headers now use proper scope attributes; keyboard focus order updated for compare toggle and date picker.
  - Added aria-labels for sparkline-less delta badges.

Implementation details
- Data fetching:
  - Added useRouteInsightsDetailQuery() hook which calls GET /v1/usage-insights/routes/{routeId} with filters: time_range, env, region, deployment_mode, project_id.
  - Query caching: 60s staleTime, 5m cacheTime; compare toggle reuses same response payload (API provides both current/prior aggregates).
- State management:
  - Compare toggle stored in URL query param compare=1 so links are shareable.
  - Route display name uses server-provided normalized_route with fallback to URL-decoded routeId.
- Metrics formatting:
  - Currency formatting standardized to FinanceFormat utils (same as billing pages).
  - Percent deltas clamp at +/- 999% and show “—” when prior=0.

Files / areas changed (high level)
- console/apps/web/src/pages/usage/insights/RouteDetailPage.tsx
- console/apps/web/src/components/usage-insights/RouteDetailHeader.tsx
- console/apps/web/src/components/usage-insights/ModelBreakdownTable.tsx
- console/apps/web/src/components/usage-insights/CostShareBar.tsx
- console/apps/web/src/hooks/useRouteInsightsDetailQuery.ts
- console/apps/web/src/lib/insights/compare.ts (delta math + edge cases)
- console/apps/web/src/styles/usage-insights.css
- console/apps/web/src/__tests__/usage-insights/route-detail.spec.tsx (new)
- console/apps/web/cypress/e2e/usage_insights_route_detail.cy.ts (updated)

Screenshots (staging)
- Route detail, compare OFF: shows KPI strip + model table
- Route detail, compare ON: shows delta badges + “what changed” callouts + model deltas

Testing
- Unit tests added for delta math edge cases (prior=0, negative deltas, missing cached_tokens)
- Component tests (RTL) for:
  - toggling compare updates URL and renders delta badges
  - empty state when API returns empty aggregates
- Cypress:
  - navigation from route list to route detail
  - compare toggle persists across reload

Rollout
- Feature flag: usage_insights_route_detail
- Not enabling by default until beta cohort is ready (PM-613 follow-up).

Checklist
- [x] Implements ENG-8427 acceptance criteria
- [x] A11y pass for keyboard + screen reader labels (basic)
- [x] Handles API partial-data + empty states
- [x] Cypress updated
- [x] Screenshot assets shared with Docs (per docs thread)

Known limitations / follow-ups
- Does not include export button in route detail yet (export is separate epic; ENG-8425).
- Model breakdown chart disabled when >12 models to avoid misleading rendering; table remains accurate.
- When route normalization collapses multiple raw routes into a single normalized route, the page uses normalized route ID (expected; see ADR).

Review conversation (highlights)
- Tessa Morgan (Design): Requested moving compare toggle into header row and aligning delta badge styling with design system. Also asked to rename “Prior” to “Previous period” and to add tooltip copy for cached tokens.
  - Felix: Implemented header layout change, updated copy, and added tooltips. Delta badge now uses DS Tag component with semantic colors.
- Paula Mendes (PM): Confirmed prior period definition must be equal-length window immediately preceding selected range; asked to show “—” when prior is zero.
  - Felix: Added compare.ts helper; delta formatting now uses “—” and avoids divide-by-zero.
- Allison Grant (SRE): Flagged potential query spam from re-rendering on date picker changes; asked to debounce input and cap retries.
  - Felix: Date picker now applies only on “Apply” click; react-query retries capped at 2, and errors surface with retry button.
- Leila Farouk (QA): Noted flaky snapshot in route-detail.spec due to locale formatting; requested stable formatting in tests.
  - Felix: Updated tests to mock Intl.NumberFormat and pinned timezone.

CI
- web:lint ✅
- web:typecheck ✅
- web:test ✅ (rerun once after snapshot fix)
- cypress:smoke ✅

Related
- PR #15462 (route detail API)
- PR #15470 (route list UI)

Co-authored-by: Alicia Perez (design QA notes applied as commits)
